summary: Checked bag arrived 41 hours late in Zurich
story: I landed in Zurich on the morning of August 4 for a week of meetings and my suitcase arrived at my hotel 41 hours later. I bought two shirts, underwear, socks and toiletries to get through the first two days. Northwind's report and my receipts are attached.

documents.name: Northwind Airlines delayed baggage report
documents.content: Northwind Airlines delayed baggage report ZRH-NW-31904. Passenger Nathan Brandt arrived Zurich ZRH August 4, 2026 at 07:50 on NW 52 from Chicago. One checked bag, tag NW 870233, not delivered on arrival. Delivered to the passenger's hotel August 6, 2026 at 00:45.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Bahnhofstrasse Herrenmode, Zurich, August 4, 2026. Two shirts, underwear, socks: $104.00. Apotheke am Paradeplatz, Zurich, August 4, 2026. Toiletries: $34.00. Card ending 5518, Nathan Brandt.
